remarks: Large studio in desirable Fountain Terrace. Spacious living area with large balcony. Engineered wood floor. Rent includes; heat, hot water cooking gas and one parking space assigned by the ground property manager upon move-in. Complex offers; In-ground pool, gym, community room, common laundry in the basement. Close proximity to shopping mall, banks, public transportation, theaters. Minutes to downtown to enjoy many restaurants. Must have good credit score. Proof of income, references, recent stubs, renters insurance, credit and background check, copy of driver license, all required. There is a move-in and move-out apply. A refundable deposit checks of $500.00 is required before move-in and move-out. Checks will be returned after the moves are completed and no damage was caused. Move-in/out operations are between 9:00am-4:00pm MON-FRI ONLY.
